title: When the Ember Turns
author: Paloma Pemberton
blurb: Oscar Ishikawa, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
